editorialSummary.heading: Rodeo Holiday, School Breaks and May Graduations
paragraphs: Holmes County students are off Friday, October 2, 2026, for Rodeo Holiday. Fall break follows on October 29–30. Classes resume Monday, November 2. Thanksgiving break runs November 23–27.

Students are off for winter break from December 21, 2026, through January 4, 2027. January 4 is a staff workday, and students return Tuesday, January 5. Spring break runs March 22–26. Classes resume Monday, March 29.

Report cards are scheduled for October 16, 2026, and January 15 and April 9, 2027. May graduation dates are May 14 for Ponce de Leon High, May 17 for Poplar Springs High, May 18 for Bethlehem High and May 20 for Holmes County High. The regular school year ends Thursday, May 27. Check with each high school for ceremony times, locations and any separate senior requirements.

The four early-release dates are October 28 and December 18, 2026, and March 19 and May 27, 2027. The first three precede fall, winter and spring breaks; May 27 is the last student day. The annual calendars do not give dismissal times, so families should use their school's notice for pickup and bus arrangements.

about.dataSource: The supplied one-page color-coded Holmes District Schools calendar matches the current official download byte for byte. The district’s matching written calendar supplies report-card dates, explicit returns and four named high-school graduations. Both calendars print Board approval on January 27, 2026, and are currently linked from Parent Resources.
about.processing: Read the full extracted text and rendered pages of both official PDFs. Orange marks teacher/student holidays on which 12-month employees work; it does not mean conditional student make-up. Yellow marks all-personnel holidays, blue staff work/pre/post-planning, pink first day/return and green early release. October 9 is an ordinary grading-period ending without early release. Student Thanksgiving covers November 23-27 regardless of separate November 25-27 employee dates. Winter Break for Students is one official December 21-January 4 range; the January 4 employee workday does not add another independent student closure and does not shorten that range. January 5, November 2 and March 29 returns are explicit official entries. Quarter starts are taken from the printed range table; the named returns also retain their grading-start meaning where applicable. One event preserves each early-release/grading/semester/last-day occurrence. Report cards are three exact issue dates from the written calendar, not distribution windows; no final fourth-quarter release or progress-report dates are invented. Graduation milestones are scoped to the four named graduating classes and do not establish attendance endpoints, campus closures, ceremony clocks or venues. Exclude FTE reporting, pre-year employee dates, paid-holiday/employee-group lines, May 28-June 1 post-planning and Memorial Day after the student year. The color PDF’s fourth-quarter range table says March 29-May 28 but its May 27 caption and grid, the written May 27 semester ending and the May 28 post-planning entry establish May 27 as the final student date. The printed 44-day quarter count matches March 29-May 27; including May 28 would make 45 weekdays. No unresolved attendance date is inferred from the inconsistent summary endpoint. The 180 annual attendance figure is derived from printed semesters 84 + 96, not separately printed as an annual total. It reconciles with quarter totals 41/43/52/44 and 207 weekdays minus 27 closures. Both source approval dates are retained; January 28 approval announcement and January 29 PDF metadata are separate from the Board date. The stale 2021-2022 metadata title does not identify the school year. The annual PDFs give no release clocks or weather reserve dates. Current year-specific Poplar Springs bell times are school-scoped, with no invented expiry or districtwide clock. The April 27 district start-times notice says no planned 2026-27 change; no legal conclusion is inferred from it.
about.updates: Current Parent Resources links, complete current PDF downloads, the available full district News listing and school bell pages were reviewed October 19, 2026. Initial DNS/timeouts produced incomplete download files; complete successful downloads were used for all source hashes and review. The full News listing includes the January 28 calendar approval announcement and April 27 start-times statement. No later student-calendar revision or dated attendance adjustment was verified. The dynamic events page did not expose individual event details in the available text; current homepage reminders agree on October 28 early release and October 29 fall break. Confirm school messages for release clocks, ceremonies and weather changes. The Holmes County High 2026-2027 bell page was found, but its image download remained incomplete after an extended approved retry, so no clock was inferred from it or from old 2022-2023 files.
about.disclaimer: This independent reference follows the district’s regular student calendar. Confirm individual school/program schedules, shortened-day transportation, ceremony details and senior obligations directly. School clocks are local Central Time.

faqs.question: When is the first day of school in Holmes County for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The first day of school is Wednesday, August 12, 2026, for students following the regular Holmes District Schools calendar.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school in Holmes County in 2027?
faqs.answer: The last student day is Thursday, May 27, 2027, with early release. One fourth-quarter summary in the color-coded calendar ends on May 28, but the dated last-day entry and written calendar identify May 27. May 28 is a staff post-planning day.

faqs.question: Which dates are no-school days for Holmes County students in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The regular student calendar lists September 7 (Labor Day), October 2 (Rodeo Holiday), October 29–30 (fall break), November 23–27 (Thanksgiving), December 21–January 4 (winter break), January 18 (Martin Luther King Jr. Day), February 15 (Presidents Day) and March 22–26 (spring break). The four early-release dates are school days, not days off.

faqs.question: Is there school on Rodeo Holiday in 2026?
faqs.answer: No. Students are off Friday, October 2, 2026, for Rodeo Holiday. With the weekend, they have three consecutive days off and are scheduled to return Monday, October 5.

faqs.question: When is fall break for Holmes County Schools in 2026?
faqs.answer: Fall break is Thursday and Friday, October 29–30, 2026. Classes resume Monday, November 2. Wednesday, October 28, is an early-release school day before the break.

faqs.question: Do students have school on October 28, 2026?
faqs.answer: Yes. Wednesday, October 28, is an early-release school day, not a day off. Fall break begins the next day, October 29. Check your school's notice for the actual dismissal time.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break for Holmes County Schools in 2026?
faqs.answer: Students are off Monday, November 23, through Friday, November 27, 2026. Including the surrounding weekends, they have nine consecutive calendar days away from regular classes. School is scheduled to resume Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: When is Christmas and winter break in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The district's Christmas/Winter Break for students runs December 21, 2026, through January 4, 2027. Friday, December 18, is an early-release school day before the break.

faqs.question: When do Holmes County students return from winter break in January 2027?
faqs.answer: Students return Tuesday, January 5, 2027. Monday, January 4, is a staff workday and remains part of the published student winter break.

faqs.question: When is spring break for Holmes County Schools in 2027?
faqs.answer: Spring break is March 22–26, 2027. Friday, March 19, is an early-release school day, and classes resume Monday, March 29.

faqs.question: Do Holmes County students have school on Good Friday in 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Good Friday, March 26, 2027, falls within the district's March 22–26 spring break.

faqs.question: Is Easter Monday a school holiday in Holmes County in 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Classes resume Monday, March 29, 2027. The approved school calendar does not give students an additional day off for Easter Monday.

faqs.question: When are the early-release days in Holmes County Schools for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The four scheduled early-release dates are October 28 and December 18, 2026, and March 19 and May 27, 2027. Students attend school on these dates but are dismissed early. May 27 is also the last student day.

faqs.question: What time does school dismiss on early-release days?
faqs.answer: The district's annual calendars list early-release dates but do not provide dismissal times. Check your school's notice for pickup, bus and childcare arrangements. Regular dismissal times do not necessarily apply.

faqs.question: When are report cards issued in Holmes County Schools in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The written district calendar lists report-card dates of October 16, 2026, January 15, 2027, and April 9, 2027. It does not specify a final fourth-quarter report-card date.

faqs.question: When do the four grading quarters begin in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The first quarter begins August 12, 2026; the second begins October 12, 2026; the third begins January 5, 2027; and the fourth begins March 29, 2027.

faqs.question: When do the grading quarters end in Holmes County Schools?
faqs.answer: The four quarter-end dates are October 9 and December 18, 2026, followed by March 19 and May 27, 2027. December 18, March 19 and May 27 are also early-release dates.

faqs.question: When do the first and second semesters end in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The first semester ends Friday, December 18, 2026, and the second semester ends Thursday, May 27, 2027. Both dates are scheduled early-release days.

faqs.question: Is October 9, 2026, an early-release day?
faqs.answer: No. Friday, October 9, marks the end of the first grading quarter, but the approved district calendar does not designate it as an early-release day or student holiday.

faqs.question: How many student attendance days are in the Holmes County 2026-2027 school year?
faqs.answer: The two published semester totals are 84 and 96 days, adding up to 180 student attendance days. The district calendar prints the semester totals rather than a separate annual total. Early-release days count as student attendance days.

faqs.question: Are Holmes County Schools closed for Labor Day in 2026?
faqs.answer: Yes. Students have no classes Monday, September 7, 2026, for Labor Day.

faqs.question: Is Veterans Day a school holiday in Holmes County in 2026?
faqs.answer: No student holiday is listed for Wednesday, November 11, 2026, in the approved district calendar. It is a scheduled school day unless the district or school announces a change.

faqs.question: Are Holmes County Schools closed on Martin Luther King Jr. Day in 2027?
faqs.answer: Yes. Monday, January 18, 2027, is a student holiday, with no regular classes scheduled.

faqs.question: Are Holmes County Schools closed for Presidents Day in 2027?
faqs.answer: Yes. Students have no classes Monday, February 15, 2027, for Presidents Day.

faqs.question: When are the Holmes County high school graduations in 2027?
faqs.answer: The district's written calendar lists Ponce de Leon High School on May 14, Poplar Springs High School on May 17, Bethlehem High School on May 18 and Holmes County High School on May 20, 2027. Ceremony times and locations must be confirmed with each school.

faqs.question: When is Ponce de Leon High School graduation in 2027?
faqs.answer: Ponce de Leon High School graduation is scheduled for Friday, May 14, 2027.

faqs.question: When is Poplar Springs High School graduation in 2027?
faqs.answer: Poplar Springs High School graduation is scheduled for Monday, May 17, 2027.

faqs.question: When is Bethlehem High School graduation in 2027?
faqs.answer: Bethlehem High School graduation is scheduled for Tuesday, May 18, 2027.

faqs.question: When is Holmes County High School graduation in 2027?
faqs.answer: Holmes County High School graduation is scheduled for Thursday, May 20, 2027.

faqs.question: What time and where are the 2027 Holmes County high school graduations?
faqs.answer: The district's written calendar provides graduation dates for four high schools but does not list ceremony times or locations. Check announcements from the specific high school for those details.

faqs.question: Do Holmes County high school seniors finish classes before graduation?
faqs.answer: The district calendar lists graduation ceremonies but does not give separate final attendance dates or exam schedules for seniors. Check with your high school about remaining classes, exams and graduation requirements.

faqs.question: What are Poplar Springs School's regular hours in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The published 2026-2027 bell schedule lists a 7:55 a.m. first bell, an 8:00 a.m. tardy bell and 2:38 p.m. dismissal for all students. The entry gate opens at 7:30 a.m. These are regular school-day times in Central Time, not districtwide or early-release hours.

faqs.question: Are Holmes County school start times changing for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: In an April 27, 2026, announcement, the superintendent said the district had no plans to change its traditional school start times for 2026-2027. Check your individual school's current bell schedule for exact times.

faqs.question: Does the 2026-2027 calendar include hurricane make-up days?
faqs.answer: The approved district calendars do not designate specific hurricane make-up dates. If weather causes a closure, check district announcements and school messages for any changes to the published schedule.

faqs.question: Where can I download the official Holmes County school calendar for 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The Holmes District Schools Parent Resources page provides the color-coded and written 2026-2027 calendars, approved January 27, 2026. The written version also lists report-card dates and high school graduations. Check district news and school notices for later updates.
